scope: Reviewer checks of exported initial-response text only; no worker files or worker tools executed.

statusUpdate.wordCountingRule: Whitespace-delimited words, excluding the three Markdown bullet markers.

mapDistinct.source: Exact JavaScript code block extracted from the exported worker response.

checks.name: Representative JavaScript keys, signed zeros, NaN, and object identity
Falsy values, objects, symbols, and promises are cached unchanged
Input-order key calls and first-item transform indexes
Every tested thrown value propagates identically and stops immediately
Frozen input and contained objects remain unchanged
Empty input invokes neither callback and returns an empty array
